sup:DEMO-F1.text:
Guten Tag,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. 

As a family-run foundry, we deeply value our long relationship and take great pride in the dedication of our skilled team. In light of current market conditions, WAGES-METAL rose 3.1 % in twelve months and is 28 % of our cost. 

We are pleased to submit our offer at a price of €52.90 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 12 months, valid from 1 December 2026. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

We look forward to continuing our trustful cooperation and working together with you.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH

move.subject: Re: Pump housing PH-100: the foundry wants +8.8 %
move.body:
Dear your company team,

You place your skilled team alongside our long relationship—it sounds like continuity matters to you as much as recognition of rising costs. We want to sustain that partnership with a fair adjustment grounded in your stated wage-cost share and our should-cost assessment. How could a longer contract horizon help you support a price adjustment that reflects the underlying cost change?

We confirm a binding volume of 4,000 units per year for 24 months. Our should-cost estimate for this part is on record (cost:part:PH-100).

On this basis we propose the attached term sheets (EUR 48.92 per unit, 60 days payment, 24 months, from 2026-12-01). Please let us know which option works best for you.

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

move.text:
Guten Tag,
Thank you for your letter - it is always good to hear from you, and I answer it myself, as I do for all the customers we have known for a long time.
We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows.
Our terms: a price of €51.20 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a contract term of 24 months, valid from 1 December 2026.
A few words from the foundry on this.
We checked the should cost data you cited; it holds and we took it into account.
We appreciate your commitment to a 24-month contract and the binding volume of 4,000 units per year, which provides valuable stability for our continued partnership.
However, extending payment terms to 60 days is not feasible for our operations, so we must maintain our standard 30-day terms.
Alternatively, with Zahlungsziel 30 days net: €50.90 per unit.
Our general terms and conditions apply; the quote lists our standard terms.
A binding higher volume would help us and can improve the price.
Which volume can you commit to?
Our price reflects our costs; our calculation stays internal.
We have worked together for many years, and I am confident that we will find a fair way forward, as we always have between our two houses.
Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH

move.subject: Re: Pump housing PH-100: the foundry wants +8.8 %
move.body:
Dear your company team,

You welcome the security of a longer partnership while stressing that payment timing must support your operations—it sounds like stability needs to cover both demand and cash flow. We want a lasting agreement grounded in the cost evidence you have confirmed, with dependable, on-time payment. How can we turn that shared basis into an agreement that protects the operating stability you need?

We confirm a binding volume of 4,000 units per year for 24 months.

On this basis we propose the attached term sheets (EUR 49.23 per unit, 60 days payment, 24 months, from 2026-12-01). Please let us know which option works best for you.

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

Dear your company team,

You ask for the basis of our figures while keeping your own calculation private—it sounds like you want an explainable agreement without opening your books. We respect that boundary and want a fair adjustment that sustains our long-standing partnership on both sides. What external cost benchmarks would you consider a sound shared basis for agreeing that adjustment?

We confirm a binding volume of 4,000 units per year for 24 months. What is the lowest price at which you can sign these terms today?

On this basis we propose the attached term sheets (EUR 49.47 per unit, 60 days payment, 24 months, from 2026-12-01). Please let us know which option works best for you.

Attached: our monthly call-off schedule for the full contract term.

Kind regards,
